title: Canonical source coordinates for the integral trace transpose
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient conventions, finite coefficient fields inside the fixed algebraic closure, and their actual completed integral uniform finite-Tor categories. For a separated finite-type map f:X→Y of finite-type schemes over the fixed field, fix a compactification and the published exceptional/scalar operation system. For each finite coefficient field E and d≥0, let 1_E be the regular completed coefficient sheaf in degree zero, T_E the positive Tate line placed in degree -2d, and H_E the full-subcategory lift of ordinary tensor T_E⊗Lf*_E(-). It has the canonical completed-pullback/twist/shift presentation Lf*_E(-)(d)[2d]. Its signed total representative is the tensor of the one-term line with exact termwise inverse image. Retain the existing coefficient extension and chi realization, the normalized compact-support comparison c, the natural mate b of c inverse, the published projection PF, and define integrated(t,K) by inverse PF, tensoring t with the identity, and unit cancellation through the support realization. Define gamma(t,K) as the specified adjunction transpose. Every operation is the recorded one; no trace hypothesis or trace invertibility is part of these definitions. Notions used: [def-pur-conventions], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [def-weil-triangulated-category], [def-weil-linear-functor], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison], [def-exchange-projection], [fix-prop-projection-formula], [def-sf-operation-stages], [def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports], [def-sf-orientation-scalar-line-comparisons]. The projection and adjoint-transpose formulas specialize the existing composite maps [def-pur-adic-projection-trace-data] to the shifted Tate line and the specified exceptional realization; the new source coordinates retain their full signed representative comparison. Definition owners also used: [def-sf-normalized-constant-coefficient-scalar-unit], [def-weil-constant-coefficient-objects], [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data], [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], [def-sf-orientation-integral-line-comparisons], [def-dl-a1-locally-constructible-adic-heart], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [def-pur-integral-derived-operations].
